rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a fair-quality blastocyst and C-grade TE, but it overstates confidence in visible ICM cell count and discusses hatching/day-4 timing somewhat inconsistently with the image and provided grading.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, BMI, prior miscarriage, semen quality, and endometrium well, with appropriate emphasis that patient factors are favorable relative to embryo quality.
Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with conclusions broadly supported by morphology and clinical context; only minor tension around stage interpretation and day-4/blastocyst framing.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with standard IVF practice, including SET, avoiding routine add-ons, and reserving expanded workup for recurrent failure/loss; minor imprecision around Gardner stage terminology prevents a perfect score.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including luteal support, monitoring, cohort review, and when to consider further evaluation, though some advice remains somewhat general.
